title.zh: 在伊莎贝拉省设立Ramon市镇的法案
title.en: An Act Creating the Municipality of Ramon in the Province of Isabela
title.orig: An Act Creating the Municipality of Ramon in the Province of Isabela

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3320_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barrios of Bugallon, Burgos, San Miguel, San Sebastian, Raniag and Pagrang-ayan are separated from the Municipality of Santiago, and the barrios of Oscariz, Nagbacalan and Bantug Petinez are separated from the Municipality of San Mateo, all in the Province of Isabela, and constituted into a new and separate municipality of said province to be known as the Municipality of Ramon, with the seat of government at the present site of the barrio of Burgos.

This Act shall take effect upon the election of the new municipal officials in the general election for local officials in November of nineteen hundred sixty-three.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
